description: This file defines the SupportAppClient class, a specialized AWS client to interact with the AWS Support App service, including methods for managing Slack channel configurations and workspace settings.

classes.name: SupportAppClient
classes.description: Extends AwsClient to provide methods for the AWS Support App service interactions, especially related to Slack configurations.

methods.name: createSlackChannelConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a Slack channel configuration for the support app.

methods.name: createSlackChannelConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a Slack channel configuration.

methods.name: deleteSlackChannelConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a Slack channel configuration.

methods.name: deleteSlackWorkspaceConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a Slack workspace configuration.

methods.name: putAccountAlias
methods.description: Creates or updates an account alias.

methods.name: putAccountAliasAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates an account alias.

methods.name: registerSlackWorkspaceForOrganization
methods.description: Registers a Slack workspace for an organization.

methods.name: registerSlackWorkspaceForOrganizationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously registers a Slack workspace for an organization.

methods.name: updateSlackChannelConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a Slack channel configuration.
